statements.Closure: 一个关系所传递的，恰好达到其闭包
statements.Balance: 一个水平由所给与所取而变化，在每一步，也在每一段上
statements.Finite runs: 当一个列表包含每一构型时，一条律恰在每一构型都返回之处不并合（`Law.lossless_iff_returns`）；对每一条律，无须列表，一个构型恰在它不返回之处被吸入（`Law.drawn_iff_not_returns`）；当每一个无上升而后有最小下降的进程都终止时，沿一条不上升的线的下降不会再现，而在有限预算之内，最小损失使这些进程终止（`Amounts.rests`）；静止不是被吸入的一种情形
statements.Lumping: 一个单独读取的部分恰在其余部分对它不造成差别之处带有一条律
statements.Widening: 扩大（包含并超出）是非自反、单向且传递的；在延续条件之下，它是保留并添加；更广者更好，是 C 的读法

en.title: The {n} central declarations and the grammar’s laws
en.subtitle: Each square is one central declaration, a Lean statement that a row of the coverage file names as central (its {cov} rows, phases, differentiations and domains, list {rows} central rows, nine declarations twice, so {n} distinct), placed by its standing against the edge of one root, how far the one root reaches (08 §7). {derived} are read as cases of grammar laws and {hyp} as a root form at one step, under a stated hypothesis; the rest are counting, below the grammar, or stand at a named distance, each with its reason.
en.distance: {n} at a named distance, each with its reason
footer: A named distance says why a declaration is not read as a case of grammar laws; the edge record does not show that a distance is a gap or a failure. The two readings most ranking results take, the continuation condition for scope and C for order, are not among these: neither stands on the edge.

Each declaration's standing is in the edge record, one-root-to-its-edge: {b} have a basis in words, in its data, and the other {r} the label a rule gives; the page of each record whose laws name a declaration prints its standing, with what it rests on. 08 §7's table of standings gives no reason for the classes with balance in their statements (it gives an example), on amounts and laws of their models, and places the 16 at a represented model and the 6 on their own carrier by F5's verified items: theorems, each carried by a law, that state a row of that law's record at a represented model or on the row's own carrier; shared_laws.py verifies what the Lean can show, and that a theorem states its row is a reader's judgment. The terms edge of one root, derived and named distance are in GLOSSARY.md.
Generated by tools/research/spine.py from shared-laws.json and spine.json.

zh.title: {n} 项核心声明与文法之律
zh.subtitle: 每个方块是一项核心声明，即覆盖文件的某一行列为核心的一个 Lean 陈述（其 {cov} 行，即阶段、分化、领域，共列 {rows} 个核心行，其中九项声明列了两次，故为 {n} 项不同的声明），按其相对于根之边（单一之根所达到之处）的位置排列（08 §7）。{derived} 项被读作文法之律的情形，{hyp} 项被读作一个根形式的一步，在一个所述的假设之下；其余或为计数，位于文法以下，或处于一个指明的距离，各有其理由。
zh.distance: {n} 项处于一个指明的距离，各有其理由
footer: 指明的距离说的是一项声明为何不被读作文法之律的情形；根之边的记录并不表明有距离就是缺口或失败。多数排序结果所取的两种读法，定范围的延续条件与定次序的 C，不在其中：二者都不在根之边上。

每项声明的位置见根之边的记录（one-root-to-its-edge）：{b} 项有文字的依据，在其数据中，其余 {r} 项是规则所给的标签；凡其律中列有某项声明的记录，其页面印出该声明的位置及其所依。08 §7 的表对“陈述中有平衡”（附一例）、“依于数量”“为其模型之律”三类未列理由，并依 F5 已核验的项定出在一个被表示的模型上的 16 项与在其自身的载体上的 6 项：这些项是各由一条律所带、在一个被表示的模型上或在该行自身的载体上陈述该律之记录中某一行的定理；shared_laws.py 核验 Lean 能显示的部分，一个定理确实陈述其行，这是读者的判断。根之边、推导而得、指明的距离这几个词，见 GLOSSARY.zh.md。
图中文字为 AI 所译，义以英文版为准。由 tools/research/spine.py 依 shared-laws.json 与 spine.json 画出。
